reply.text:
Cutting weight in three days is one for a doctor or a registered dietitian, not a coach. Rapid cuts through dehydration, restricting food or sweating it off carry real risk, and I won't give you tips for them. If you're close to the limit, your coach or a sports dietitian can look at your actual numbers and tell you whether to compete at this weight or move up a class.

What I can do is keep your training sensible this week so you arrive fresh. Want me to set up a light session for today?
